title: Quo Vadis, Driving Scene Reconstruction? Occlusion-Aware Gaussian Densification
abstract: arXiv:2611.06273v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While recent feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting methods enable efficient driving-scene reconstruction from surround-view images, their reliance on a single observation fundamentally hinders novel-view synthesis. Regions occluded in the input can become visible from novel viewpoints, leaving the reconstructed Gaussians under-constrained and incomplete. Moving beyond image-space inpainting for rendered views, we introduce OccSplat, a feed-forward framework whose core contribution is Occlusion-Aware Gaussian Densification, explicitly targeting missing scene geometry rather than missing pixels. By predicting new Gaussian primitives for unsupported regions, OccSplat completes the scene directly in the 3D representation. Specifically, OccSplat first identifies occluded regions that lack Gaussian support through Gaussian Occlusion Mapping. Gaussian Occlusion Completion then generates new primitives for these regions. translated_title: 驾驶场景重建将何去何从？遮挡感知的高斯稠密化
translated_abstract: 尽管近期的前馈式3D高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting）方法能够从环视图像中高效地重建驾驶场景，但其对单一观测的依赖从根本上限制了新视角合成的效果。输入中被遮挡的区域在新视角下可能变得可见，这导致重建出的高斯表示约束不足且不完整。为了超越仅对渲染视图进行图像空间修复的思路，我们提出了OccSplat——一个前馈框架，其核心贡献是遮挡感知的高斯稠密化，明确针对缺失的场景几何而非缺失的像素。通过为缺乏支撑的区域预测新的高斯基元，OccSplat直接在3D表示层面完成场景补全。具体而言，OccSplat首先通过高斯遮挡图识别出缺乏高斯支撑的遮挡区域，随后由高斯遮挡补全模块为这些区域生成新的基元。所预测的基元……
tldr: OccSplat提出遮挡感知的高斯稠密化方法，通过高斯遮挡图识别缺乏高斯支撑的遮挡区域，并在3D表示中直接预测新的高斯基元以补全缺失的场景几何，从而提升前馈式3D高斯泼溅在驾驶场景新视角合成中的完整性。
en_tdlr: OccSplat introduces Occlusion-Aware Gaussian Densification, which identifies occluded regions lacking Gaussian support via Gaussian Occlusion Mapping and predicts new Gaussian primitives directly in the 3D representation, completing missing scene geometry to improve novel-view synthesis in feed-forward driving-scene reconstruction.
